output.subject: Re: Loan application status
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us. You told us you applied for a personal loan on 8/23/2026 and haven't heard anything since, and you asked whether there is a way to check the status of your application.

We understand that waiting without an update can be unsettling, especially when you may be planning around the outcome. We have passed your question to our Consumer Lending team, who will look into where your application stands and let you know how you can check on its progress.

We will respond within 10 business days. In the meantime, if there is anything else you would like us to know about your application, please reply to this email and we will make sure it reaches the team.

Thank you for your patience, and for applying with us.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a status question, not a complaint; consider giving the current application status directly if it is available.
Confirm a personal loan application dated 8/23/2026 exists for this customer and check its current stage.
Add the specific ways the customer can check application status; none were described in the draft.
If a decision or request for more information was already sent, tell the customer and confirm their contact details.
Consider whether a faster reply than 10 business days is appropriate given the time already waited.
